summary: Exhaustive forward/reverse matrices align. Instruction states the incident end-state and binds control-plane-contract.md for IAM, quorum/fast-forward merge (including protected lease), exactly-once deliver/event_id, audit, and outbox enqueue/retry; every substantive verifier assertion maps to that surface or to discoverable ops/policy evidence. Remaining gaps are advisory only (HTTP 403 vs 400 looseness, approvals sort order, failed-outbox retry ladder, Action-* Condition non-waiver).

Binding CLI/HTTP/IAM/PR-store/approvals+FF+lease/deliver+event_id+outbox HMAC/audit contract with absolute paths and success/error shapes.

main/release require_lease + linear history; lease F2P discoverable with contract Approvals and merge section.
Main GitPush Bool MFA + office IpAddress; release Allow+Deny; discovers MFA/IP and explicit-deny tests.
wh-settle secret settle for settle-prod; discovers outbox webhook_id and HMAC default.

40 behavioral tests: IAM MFA/IP/deny/star/branch, quorum/author/dup/pool/FF/lease, deliver exactly-once/event_id/outbox HMAC/dispatch attempts, audit allow+deny, CLI+HTTP merge IAM, P2P clone/push/PR store/metrics/report.
PASS requires complete matrices, empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS; advisory LOWs may accompany PASS.
Instruction owns work request; delegated control-plane-contract.md is legitimate protocol/API/CLI documentation, not a second prompt.

findings.criterion: HTTP AccessDenied must be 403 per contract; verifier accepts status in (403, 400).
findings.why_it_matters: A 400+AccessDenied response could pass grading despite the documented 403 mapping. Primary IAM deny body is still enforced.

findings.criterion: Approve success approvals list must be sorted; not asserted.
findings.why_it_matters: Unsorted but unique approvals still pass. Incidental serialization relative to quorum semantics already graded.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional assert approvals == sorted(approvals) after two distinct reviewers.

findings.criterion: Outbox failed-row retry until max attempts is binding but only successful first dispatch is graded.
findings.why_it_matters: CLI dispatch uses an in-process sink so first attempt always succeeds; failed→retry ladder can be wrong without failing. Enqueue + attempts/status persistence remain covered.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional force a failed attempt then assert status failed and a later retry increments attempts.

findings.criterion: Action * must not waive Condition; star F2P only proves Resource non-waiver on sandbox.
findings.why_it_matters: Condition waiver under * is not separately exercised. Resource boundary coverage is material and present.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional policy/fixture where * Allow would pass only if Conditions were waived.
